diagnostics.name: Backend verifier

items.text: The interrogation session of Shiva Zarei was held at the first interrogation branch of Boein Zahra Public and Revolutionary Prosecutor's Office. She was released on bail after the session. The session took place in the Public and Revolutionary Prosecutor's Office of Boein Zahra county.

Iran International audiences say the increase in gasoline prices affects the cost of goods and increases household financial pressure. They believe this price hike will intensify inflation and shrink people's livelihoods. An interview was conducted with Baharan Azadi, a member of Iran International's editorial team.

Farahnaz Espad, a journalist and presenter at Iran International, passed away at the age of 37 after battling cancer for two years. She had been working with Iran International for eight years and was unable to work due to her illness. Iran International expressed condolences to her family and audience.

A member of the Supreme Council of Provinces warned that 400 villages in South Khorasan are supplied with water by tanker. Excessive groundwater extraction and reduced rainfall have caused a drop in aquifer levels and land subsidence. This crisis has affected farmers' livelihoods and led to rural migration.

The head of Esteghlal Football Club's organization announced that the Asian Football Confederation opposed the team's hosting in Iraq and Uzbekistan. Esteghlal's proposal to hold matches in these two countries was rejected. The final decision on the venue will be announced in the next few hours.

A business unit in Isfahan was closed due to selling T-shirts with images deemed against trade regulations by the police. The police declared these designs as violating the rules. This action was taken by the relevant authorities.

Ali Shirazi stated that the President of the Kurdistan Region of Iraq has been added as a communication channel between the IRGC and Washington. This indicates that Trump is seeking dialogue with centers of power and military commanders of the Islamic Republic to achieve a lasting agreement.

Foolad Khuzestan club announced that Ramin Rezaeian has joined the team. Rezaeian said goodbye to Esteghlal fans on Instagram and emphasized that he fought for them until the last day of his contract. Upon arriving in Ahvaz, he said he owes the World Cup to the city and has come to make the fans happy.

Alireza Jafarzadeh, a master's student in international political economy at Beheshti University, has been sentenced to a temporary suspension from studies for two semesters. His disciplinary ruling was finalized by the university's appeals council. The proposal for his expulsion has also been referred to the Student Affairs Organization for decision.

Several employees of the Pars Oil and Gas Company held protests in various sections and offshore platforms in the South Pars and Asaluyeh region. They demanded the removal of salary caps, full payment of wages, and revision of minimum wages. They also requested not to merge the oil pension fund with other pension funds and called for addressing their other demands.

The governor of Khorasan Razavi attributed the December 2025 protests to enemy interference. He also acknowledged responsibilities and structural mistakes in this regard. He emphasized the need to create an environment of interaction with the youth.

Donald Trump posted an image of the Strait of Hormuz map and parts of Iran, the Persian Gulf, and the Sea of Oman on the Truth Social network. The image includes the phrase "New American Territory" and the Strait of Hormuz is circled. Trump did not provide any further explanation about the image.

Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, the Speaker of the Parliament, said the enemy seeks to create chaos, terror, and separatist actions. He added that the enemy intends to exploit potential dissatisfaction regarding gasoline. Ghalibaf emphasized that resolving this challenge can disappoint the enemy.

A mother in Markazi province reported her family's inability to afford the medication for her 36-year-old child with ALS. The cost of 13 prescribed ampoules is about 65 billion tomans, which the family cannot cover even by selling a three-billion-toman house. Efforts to seek help from medical centers and various institutions have only resulted in promises of 500 to 600 million tomans in aid.

Kazem Gharibabadi reacted to Donald Trump's image of the Strait of Hormuz, calling it an illusion. He stated that this illusion will soon be corrected. Trump had posted an image titled "New American Territory" showing the Strait of Hormuz.

Today, Tuesday, 27 Mordad, a group of applicants for the land of Shahid Madani Cooperative in Tabriz protested the prolonged uncertainty of their case in front of the East Azerbaijan Governor's Office.
A resident of Isfahan stated that he paid nearly one million tomans for breakfast groceries. This amount exceeds his entire daily wage. This indicates a sharp increase in food costs.

The asphalt paving operation on the bed of the Aligudarz River was carried out without a permit and has been halted until a technical decision is made. The municipality made a mistake in this operation. The Lorestan Regional Water Company issued a written warning and experts are investigating the matter.

The Speaker of the Iranian Parliament criticized the government's increase in gasoline prices, calling it an uncalculated measure and claiming that the enemy has planned to create unrest. He emphasized that the gasoline shortage problem should be solved with comprehensive and smart planning. Masoud Pezeshkian also acknowledged the impact of the US naval blockade on gasoline imports.

Nechirvan Barzani, the head of the Kurdistan Region of Iraq, has made efforts to establish contact between the US and the IRGC. These contacts began in early March to reduce tensions between Tehran and Washington. The Kurdistan Region spokesman confirmed the news, but Iran and the IRGC have denied it.

Last night, a group of citizens gathered in front of Sanandaj prison demanding the halt of Kaveh Rafusheh's death sentence. He had been sentenced to death for murder. His execution was carried out early Tuesday morning, August 17, at Sanandaj prison.

The Qatari Foreign Ministry spokesperson called Iran's request for the Red Cross to intervene in the Iranian pilots' issue a media trick. Qatar stated that its invitation to the Iranian delegation to review the case remains valid. Iran has not yet responded to this invitation.

The President of the United States, Donald Trump, on Tuesday, 27 Mordad, in a post on Truth Social, again called the Strait of Hormuz 'territory of the United States'. He published a graphic image in which the Strait of Hormuz is marked as 'new territory' of the United States. Trump had previously, in a speech, introduced this waterway as part of US territory.

Frequent power outages in Falard county, Chaharmahal and Bakhtiari province, have caused financial damage to a baker. This issue is shown in a video published on social media. The damage caused by these outages has attracted attention.

Donald Trump posted an image on the social network Truth Social showing a map of the Strait of Hormuz and parts of Iran, the Persian Gulf, and the Sea of Oman. The image includes the phrase "New American Territory" and highlights the Strait of Hormuz with a circle. This occurred amid ongoing tensions between the Islamic Republic and the United States in the region.

A citizen reported in a video to Iran International that the water flow in Mahmoudabad city, Mazandaran province, has been cut off for some time. He said that not even a drop of water is flowing in the pipes. This issue has caused concerns in the city.

Uzi Dayan, former deputy chief of staff of the Israeli army, stated that Israel cannot rely on the US regarding Iran and must rely on itself. He emphasized that Israel fights for its vital and existential needs and must be fully prepared defensively and offensively. Dayan added that conditions may change at any moment, and Israel must be fully ready.

Trump stated that there are no ongoing or planned negotiations with the Islamic Republic of Iran. He said the naval blockade continues with full force and the Strait of Hormuz is open and active. Additionally, all naval mines have been cleared or detonated.

Donald Trump stated that there are no ongoing or planned negotiations with the Islamic Republic. He also said the naval blockade remains fully in place and the Strait of Hormuz is open and active. All naval mines have been cleared or detonated.

Reuters reported that Iran's oil exports have dropped to less than 300,000 barrels per day this month. Homayoun Falakshahi attributed this decline to the US naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz. The blockade is being seriously enforced.

Mohammadreza Zafarghandi, the Minister of Health, stated that 50,000 deaths annually are attributed to air pollution. He compared this number to 20,000 deaths caused by accidents. The Minister emphasized that health issues require attention to social and environmental factors.

Six commercial units in the counties of Nikshahr and Tabas were sealed by order of judicial and law enforcement authorities. Some of these closures in Tabas were attributed to the publication of images and videos related to non-compliance with hijab in cyberspace.

The Qatari Foreign Ministry spokesman stated that Iranian warplanes entered Qatar's airspace to target its sovereignty. After the pilots did not respond to communications, they were engaged according to rules of engagement. Qatar recovered the body of one pilot and called Iran's statements baseless.

Jafar Panahpour, a wildlife cameraman, released a video showing five gray wolves in Golestan National Park. He explained that wolves live and hunt in family packs. These cohesive groups play an important role in maintaining ecosystem health.

A citizen from Gilan province reports frequent power outages during hot and humid days in the villages of the province. These outages occur simultaneously with the activities of rice farmers. He criticizes this situation.

Hassan Hassanzadeh, commander of Tehran province's IRGC, said people have participated in the war with a sense of responsibility from the beginning. He emphasized that people's support for the system and revolution will continue. This presence will last until the enemy becomes discouraged from continuing the war.
Mohammad Baqer Kharazi, a cleric and political activist, has been detained for about six days by order of the Special Clerical Prosecutor's Office in Qom. He remains in custody.

On Wednesday, 28 Mordad at 9 PM Tehran time, an Instagram live with Amir Pouria will discuss underground cinema in Iran. The conversation is prompted by the online release of the film "Bidad" by Sohail Beiraghi. The film is about a young singer who resists the ban on women singing in Iran.

Mohammad Mokhber stated that the Islamic Republic is logical and open to dialogue but does not confuse negotiation with surrender. He said the Islamic Republic is not warlike but will not retreat from self-defense. Mokhber also emphasized that pressure and sanctions cannot break the will of the Iranian people.

Ali Madanizadeh, the Minister of Economy, stated that the top priority of the Islamic Republic is to increase economic resilience. He emphasized the need to minimize the impact of enemy pressures on the economy. He also highlighted the importance of maximum public participation in the economy through saving and investment.
Vahid reported that a missile alert was announced in Dubai at 18:52. This news was released urgently. The exact time of the event has been specified.

A resident of Mahmoudabad reported that the electricity at his home was cut off for the third time in one day. This was reported by sending a video to Iran International. Power outages have been repeated in this area.

The National Emergency Crisis and Disaster Management Authority of the UAE announced that the country's air defense systems detected a missile threat. The threat was targeting the country. People have been advised to stay in a safe place and follow official alerts.

Abbas Araghchi stated that Masoud Pezeshkian proposed Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf for the negotiations. Araghchi said Pezeshkian insisted that Ghalibaf's name be listed as the head of negotiations in the protocol. Araghchi also mentioned that the Americans initiated the proposal for negotiations.
A group of healthcare workers held a protest in front of the Ministry of Health yesterday. They demanded attention to their job issues and living conditions. The protest took place in Tehran.
A group of healthcare workers protested in front of the Hamadan governor's office. They are protesting against working hours and salary calculations. The protest is due to job-related issues.

Fereydoun Haddad Adel spoke about Mojtaba Khamenei's family life, stating that he slept only about three hours a day and spent most of his time studying and praying. Mojtaba Khamenei also dedicated time to his children and participated in their daily affairs. The shared life of Haddad Adel's sister with Mojtaba Khamenei began in a simple, small house in Qom.

The 40th-day memorial ceremony for Ali Khamenei, the former dictator of Iran, was held on Tuesday, August 17, in Tehran. Masoud and Mostafa Hosseini Khamenei, Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, Gholamhossein Mohseni Ejei, and Esmail Qa'ani attended the ceremony. Mojtaba Khamenei was not seen at the event.

On August 18, the birthday of Asal Mansouri was commemorated beside her tomb. Asal Mansouri was a child psychologist and children's rights activist. She was killed on Friday, January 8, by a direct shot from officers.

The German government has established a new research center in Saxony-Anhalt to counter drone threats. This center will focus on identifying and tracking drones. The German Interior Minister described drone threats as part of the shadow war of the 21st century.

Mojtaba Maqiseh, a political prisoner, was released from Vakilabad Prison in Mashhad after completing his sentence. He was transferred to Khur and Biabanak County to serve a one-year exile sentence. This transfer took place on August 15.

Abdolnaser Hemmati, the Central Bank governor, said the pressures have existed from the beginning and are not new. He added that the US president's threats are also not new and they respond with maximum resistance. Hemmati emphasized that these threats will not disrupt Iran's plans.

The plan to sell surplus gasoline at 87,200 tomans per liter in Kerman was stopped before sales began. The discussion about the fourth gasoline price tier continues. People are sharing their views on how a potential price increase might affect their lives.

Steel industry retirees held a protest and march in Isfahan on August 17. They demanded attention to health insurance issues and implementation of the adjustment plan. The protest was held to realize their other demands.

Ali Maqiseh, a detained citizen from Sabzevar, was released from the city's prison on bail. This news was reported by the HRANA news agency. His release was confirmed based on information received by HRANA.

The UAE Ministry of Defense announced that it identified two ballistic missiles launched from Iran. One missile fell outside and the other inside UAE territorial waters. The ministry is at the highest level of readiness to counter any threats.

An Iranian resident in Malmö, Sweden, commemorated the martyrs of the Iranian national revolution by cooking Sholeh Zard. He also mentioned Rashid Mazaheri, former goalkeeper of Iran's national football team, who was arrested after openly criticizing Ali Khamenei and the December 1404 massacre.

Rodri, the Spanish midfielder from Manchester City, joined Barcelona with a four-year contract worth 60 million euros. He won the Ballon d'Or in 2024, becoming the first midfielder since Lothar Matthäus to receive the award. He played 298 games for Manchester City and won several major titles.

Two prisoners in Maragheh prison, sentenced to death for drug-related crimes, were transferred to solitary confinement. One of the prisoners has been identified as Shahram Bahrami from Kouhdasht. This transfer was carried out to execute their death sentences.

Hojatollah Abdolmaleki stated that recent months' inflation has absolutely no relation to the war. These remarks were made at the 40th day memorial of Ali Khamenei's burial in Koohsar city. The Minister of Cooperatives, Labor, and Social Welfare made these statements.

Qalibaf said Americans think they can gain concessions not in the agreement by increasing pressure on Iran. He added that Basent and Hegst are not capable of such actions. He also urged Americans to resolve the problems they have caused themselves.

Ali Najafi Tavana, former head of the Central Bar Association, discussed the minimum standards for prisons and the current situation of prisons in Iran. Topics such as Mandela Rules, solitary confinement, and government responsibility for prisoners' rights were addressed. Solutions for reforming the prison system from domestic and international law perspectives were also examined.

Nejat Bahrami, a political analyst, said the Islamic Republic wants to forcibly involve the region in war. The goal is to prevent Trump from maintaining calm until the November elections. After Trump's victory, confronting the Islamic Republic will become more difficult.

Mehdi Tartaar, Persepolis coach, stated that his team's playing style is a combination of Guardiola's possession, Simeone's defensive approach, and Klopp's pressing. He described the match against Esteghlal Khuzestan as one of their finals and emphasized that his team is determined to win. Tartaar also mentioned the opponent's disciplined team and coaching staff.

Esteghlal football team defeated Nassaji Mazandaran 1-0 in the second week of the Premier League. The only goal was scored by Mohammadreza Azadi in the 83rd minute. Esteghlal reached 6 points with this victory.

A 19-year-old youth shared a video with Iran International describing economic pressures and difficult working conditions. He says that due to life pressures, he looks like he is 30 years old. The video highlights economic and social challenges.

Mehdi Mahdavi Azad said the government's claims about reducing the gasoline deficit do not match reality. The consumption and production situation of gasoline in Iran is more critical than official authorities announce. He added that the Islamic Republic has no choice but to increase gasoline prices to compensate for the fuel imbalance.

Employees of Zahedan University of Medical Sciences, Iranshahr municipality staff, and workers of Lar copper and gold mine reported unpaid wage arrears. Some workers at Lar mine faced threats of dismissal when demanding their overdue wages.

Jean-Yves Le Drian, the French foreign minister, announced that two Iranian diplomats will be expelled from France in the coming days. He stated this action is in response to the assault on two French diplomats on July 19. Le Drian also emphasized that the Iranian people are the main victims of Middle East tensions.

Israel's defense minister, Yisrael Katz, stated that Israel's policy in Gaza is to eliminate threats, kill terrorists, and take revenge on those involved in the October 7 massacre. He said the Israeli army has acted on this policy by killing Hamas terrorists and will continue to do so. The goal is to protect Israeli forces and ensure calm in southern settlements.

Tractor football team defeated Sepahan 2-0 in the second week of the Premier League in Isfahan. Both goals were scored by Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh. With this victory, Tractor reached 6 points and is currently in second place in the league table.

The director of forensic medicine in Kermanshah reported the death of 11 workers and injury of 281 others due to work-related accidents in the first four months of the year. Falling from heights was the main cause of worker deaths. These statistics pertain to Kermanshah province.

Residents of Mazandaran and relatives of several martyrs from Rostamkola who were killed in the protests on January 8 and 9 wrote their names on white balloons in their memory. These balloons were placed on cars in the city. The video was released by Iran International.

Farzin Karbasi stated that the President of the Kurdistan Region mediated between the US and the IRGC. The Islamic Republic and the IRGC have tried to deny this communication channel. Qa'ani also played a role in establishing this contact.

Nine citizens from Esfarayen arrested in connection with the December 2025 protests remain in legal uncertainty. Seven have been transferred to Bojnord prison, while two under-18 defendants are held in a correctional center. Some face charges including moharebeh and corruption on earth.

Aram Hasami stated that the main issue for the Islamic Republic is now the Strait of Hormuz, and Tehran signals that there is no solution without lifting sanctions. Houshang Hassaniyari believes that during the Trump administration, a full-scale war option against the Islamic Republic was considered. This war could paralyze the Islamic Republic and lead to a change in the situation.

The UAE has suspended all trade and financial transactions with Iran until further notice. This decision was made due to escalating regional tensions. The UAE emphasizes its commitment to dialogue and regional cooperation.

The UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs announced the suspension of all trade, commercial exchanges, and financial transactions with Iran until further notice. This decision was made following the missile attack by the Islamic Republic. The UAE emphasized its commitment to dialogue and regional cooperation.
The audio version of program 24 with Fardad Farahzad about the cut of communications between Iran and the USA has been released.

The Iranian Constitutional Party (Liberal Democrat) reported an assassination attempt on Fouad Pashaei, the party's secretary-general. The incident occurred on Monday at 7:45 PM Los Angeles time, and Pashaei is currently in intensive care. The Los Angeles police are investigating the incident, and no further details have been released.

The Moscow-based newspaper Vedomosti wrote in an analysis that joint US military exercises with South Korea are costly and an obstacle to normalizing dialogue with North Korea. The newspaper quoted political science expert Malek Dadakov as saying that disputes over the promised $350 billion South Korean investment in the US and the cost of Washington's military presence were factors in the decision, and that Trump wants Seoul to increase its share of funding for US forces and the Iran issue also played a role. Vedomosti also quoted Pavel Koshkin, a researcher at the Russian Academy of Sciences, as saying the reduction in exercises could signal US willingness to resume dialogue with North Korea.

Esmaeil Baghayi, spokesperson for Iran's Foreign Ministry, denied the claim that Iran launched a missile at the UAE. He described the UAE's behavior as disruptive to efforts to build regional trust. These remarks were in response to the claim made by the UAE.

Morad Vaisi, a senior analyst at Iran International, said that the Islamic Republic officials mean the endurance of the regime, not the people, when they talk about resilience. He emphasized that people must endure inflation and livelihood problems. He questioned where the human and Iranian citizen fit in this definition.

Donald Trump, the President of the United States, had a phone call with Mohammed bin Zayed, the President of the UAE, on Tuesday. They discussed opportunities for cooperation and strengthening relations in line with mutual interests. They also exchanged views on the latest developments in the Middle East.

Morad Veysi, a senior analyst at Iran International, referred to the disappearance of 13 Iranian fishermen and the authorities' and provincial media's neglect of their fate. He said this shows that citizens' lives are not a priority for the Islamic Republic. He described this indifference as a reflection of an approach where the Iranian human and their life are among the last concerns of government officials.

With the expiration of the 60-day deadline for the US and Islamic Republic to reach an agreement, an American official told Al Jazeera that Donald Trump has asked his team not to negotiate with the Islamic Republic until it declares full readiness for an agreement.

Mark Montgomery called Donald Trump's threat to bomb Oman exaggerated. He said Trump intended to remind Oman to adhere to international laws. He also described Oman as a long-term ally and partner of the United States.

The Iraqi government approved mechanisms for crude oil exports through specialized domestic and international companies. These mechanisms will be implemented from September 1 for three months. This decision was announced after the cabinet meeting.

The plan to sell surplus gasoline in Kerman at 87,200 tomans per liter has been halted due to lack of coordination. The plan was about to be implemented but is currently stopped. The discussion about a fourth gasoline price remains on the government's agenda.
Farahnaz Espad, a journalist and presenter at Iran International, has passed away. The Iran International family announced this news. A program will be held in memory of her and Reza Haghighatnejad.

The Institute for Science and International Security released satellite images showing limited vehicle activity at the Isfahan nuclear complex. Several container trucks and cars are seen in various parts of the complex. Tunnel entrances remain blocked with no signs of excavation as of August 3.

CNN reported, citing American officials, that US President Donald Trump is dissatisfied with Tehran's unwillingness to respond to his demands. The officials said Trump intends to wait until the leaders of the Islamic Republic show a new willingness to reach the agreement he wants. CNN also reported, citing these officials, that very severe sanctions are expected to be imposed against the Islamic Republic soon.

The US State Department has offered up to $10 million for information about five men accused of hacking and stealing data related to the US and its allies from the Islamic Republic. These individuals have ties to the Ministry of Intelligence and the IRGC and targeted critical US infrastructure. Their names are Behzad Masri, Keyvan Fayyaz, Mojtaba Ghalehkouhi, Arman Kahzadian, and Saber Shahbazi.

Kazem Jalali, Iran's ambassador in Moscow, stated that Ukraine has not yet paid compensation to Tehran for the attack on a ship in the Caspian Sea. Talks for compensation and damage reimbursement are ongoing. Jalali hopes the negotiations will be successful.

The Coalition of Political Forces of Kurdistan of Iran described Khomeini's jihad fatwa on August 19, 1979, as a systematic revenge against the people of Kurdistan. The coalition referred to the attacks by the Revolutionary Guards on Kurdistan cities and summary executions. It also emphasized the resistance of the Kurdish people and the need for solidarity among democratic forces.

Damascus has requested an agreement with the US and Israel to establish a joint coordination center in Jordan. The aim of this center is to prevent escalation of tensions. This report was published by Axios quoting a US official.

A coalition of student activists and media issued a statement saying that execution is not justice but intentional killing legalized by the state. The coalition opposes the death penalty in principle and views it as a tool of state repression. They emphasized that defending the right to life is part of the struggle for freedom and democracy.

Donald Trump has ordered a halt to talks with the Islamic Republic. The White House is about to impose new sanctions on Iran and is pursuing a strategy of gradually increasing pressure. Washington opposes a potential agreement between Iran and Oman regarding the Strait of Hormuz.

CNN reported that the battle for control of the Strait of Hormuz has become the main axis of the Iran war, with the US holding a superior naval position. Over 80% of ships in the past two weeks have passed through the Oman route, which Iran opposes. The US opposes any agreement that would allow Tehran to control or collect tolls.

The US State Department announced that Marco Rubio and Sheikh Tahnoun bin Zayed discussed regional security and countering the Islamic Republic. Rubio emphasized the importance of freedom of navigation through the Strait of Hormuz. The discussion focused on coordination between the two countries on security issues.

Michael Duffy, the US Deputy Secretary of Defense, stated that the US military is capable of facing any threat and that the Trump administration focuses on rebuilding military strength and defense industries. He added that missile and weapon production is increasing and new contracts with defense companies are being signed. These remarks come amid concerns about US arms stockpiles.

Officials from Gulf countries feel caught in the middle of tensions between Tehran and Washington. They do not want intensified conflicts but believe that Washington's lack of response encourages the Islamic Republic to increase attacks. Gulf Arab countries believe Iran will respond to increased economic pressures with military action, leading to renewed escalations.

Choo Hyun, South Korea's foreign minister, stated that Donald Trump's message about reducing joint military exercises included pressure on Seoul to participate in a war with Iran. These remarks were made on Wednesday. The foreign minister referred to this issue.

Kayhan newspaper described the Islamabad agreement as a complete loss for Iran and beneficial to the US. It accused the US of violating its commitments and invalidating the agreement. Kayhan called for an end to the approach based on understanding with Washington.

The seized Emirati tanker in the northern corridor of the Strait of Hormuz has changed its route towards Bandar Abbas. Its initial destination was the port of Jebel Ali. This news was reported by Fars News Agency.

The United Arab Emirates has suspended all trade and financial exchanges with the Islamic Republic of Iran. This decision was made after the identification of two ballistic missiles launched from Iran. Amir Hamidi considers this action part of the economic pressure structure against Iran.

Hadi Ghavami, member of the Parliament's Planning and Budget Committee, said that people are facing unemployment, inflation, inequality, and poverty, and these issues are deepening day by day. He added that liquidity has increased from 250 billion tomans at the beginning of the revolution to over 18,200 trillion tomans. He also stated that 62 percent of the country's liquidity is concentrated in Tehran province.

Financial Times, citing sources close to the Iranian government, reported that Iran is considering attacks on military targets in southeastern Europe, including Bulgaria and Cyprus, if the war escalates due to the US. Attacks on submarine fiber optic cables in the Strait of Hormuz are also being considered. These sources stated that if the US goes too far, Iran might target locations in Europe.

Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, the Speaker of the Parliament, stated in his speech in Baghdad that the entire region considers Israel as an enemy. He said his trip to Iraq aims to accelerate a new regional order without foreign interference. Ghalibaf also emphasized the Islamic Republic's readiness for security and deep relations in the region.

The US Department of Justice announced that a 14-count supplementary indictment against 17 members of 'Mabna Institute,' a company based in Iran, was unsealed on Tuesday, 27 Mordad. According to the indictment, Mabna Institute has conducted a coordinated cyber intrusion campaign since at least 2013 targeting computer systems of 144 US universities, 178 foreign universities, at least 42 US private companies, 11 foreign private companies, at least five US federal and state government entities, and at least two non-governmental organizations.

Ali Abdollahi, Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces, stated that the southern Gulf countries should know that nothing escapes the eyes of the armed forces. He added that any assistance to the US military is considered participation with US forces. He also noted that the presence of military aircraft at regional bases without the host countries' knowledge is unlikely.

Donald Trump has ordered a halt to any negotiations with the Islamic Republic. After weeks of optimism about improving relations with Tehran, he concluded that the efforts were unsuccessful. Trump has now adopted a new approach.

Fadahossein Maleki does not rule out the possibility of an uncalculated nuclear attack by Donald Trump on Iran. He stated that Iran has entered an active and offensive deterrence phase. The Islamic Republic will respond proportionally to the type of weapon used by the US.

Price increases have reduced consumption of meat, chicken, eggs, and some other foods by 25 to 50 percent. Ali Dadpay says the decrease in food purchases does not mean lower demand but indicates households' inability to afford these items. The Planning and Budget Organization has warned about reduced ration card resources.

Anwar Gargash, diplomatic advisor to the UAE president, denied rumors about canceling worker residency or providing financial facilities to Iran. He described these rumors as part of a desperate media campaign. He also emphasized that the UAE continues its efforts to address regional developments.

China has launched its first regular shipping service in the Arctic. This route reduces the shipping time from China to the UK to 20 days. The plan is part of China and Russia's cooperation to develop the Polar Silk Road.

Ghasem Ravanbakhsh, representative of Qom, stated that 40% of the revenues from the Strait of Hormuz are allocated to strengthening the armed forces and military infrastructure, while 60% is designated for the welfare of the Iranian people. The Strait of Hormuz plan has been drafted in 12 articles. Approval of this plan could enable Iran to utilize the capacities of the Strait of Hormuz for national interests.

Mehrdad Moshtaghi's sister commemorated his memory on his 28th birthday at his grave. Mehrdad Moshtaghi was injured by a war bullet to the head on January 9 in Arak. He died four days later in the hospital.

Qods newspaper criticized the double behavior of Ramin Rezaeian, defender of Foolad Khuzestan. The newspaper pointed to the contradiction between his TV statements and the luxurious lifestyle images he shares on social media. Qods emphasized that displaying wealth during difficult economic times can create a sense of distance among people.

Eliezer Marom said Donald Trump's emphasis on controlling the Strait of Hormuz sends a message to Iranian officials that they do not control this waterway. He added that the US is trying to export oil from the Gulf region through economic pressure and naval cooperation. These actions have angered Iran, and Tehran is likely to respond.

Mehrdad Moshtaqi, a devoted fan of Esteghlal and Real Madrid, was severely injured by a bullet to the head fired by the Islamic Republic's suppression forces in Arak on January 9, 2026. He underwent surgery but died due to brain death and cardiac arrest. His brother had previously expressed his wish to watch a Real Madrid game in person.

Milad Balsini, a Turkic (Azerbaijani) activist, was arrested after attending Branch 15 of the Tabriz Prosecutor's Office. He is accused of propaganda against the regime, sending information to hostile media, and cooperating with enemy states against national security. A 30-day temporary detention order was issued for him.

Armin Noorani, a rapper known as "Khojasteh," was temporarily detained and released after giving a pledge. A video of his forced confession was released, but the conditions under which it was recorded are unclear. In the video, he expresses regret over his previous statements regarding protests.

Fazlollah Mousavi stated that the blood of the martyred leader belongs to the Islamic community and pursuing this crime is a public duty. He described revenge as a religious, revolutionary, and national demand that should be pursued with the cooperation of officials and the people. Mousavi called the assassination a complex conspiracy with internal and external layers that requires investigation of all involved parties.

Jamal Musiala explained his physical condition after falling during Bayern Munich's match against Heidenheim. He revealed a diagnosis of a treatable neurological disorder causing short-term absence seizures. Musiala expressed gratitude for the support and messages he received.

The August ration card has not been credited for households whose head of household's national ID ends with digits 7 to 9. Their credit recharge has been postponed to September 5. Other eligible groups with different digits have received their August ration cards.

Shahram Khaledi commented on France's decision to expel two Iranian diplomats due to the detention and mistreatment of two French diplomats in Tehran. He described the Islamic Republic as an aggressive and terrorist-supporting regime with a history of violating diplomatic immunity. He also said these actions have alienated countries willing to mediate with Tehran.

Rouhollah Rahimpour referred to CNN's report on the halt of talks between the US and the Islamic Republic, calling this development a strategic shift. He said this change affects not only the pressure tools but also Washington's logic for achieving political goals.

The head of the Cyber Police Center announced the identification and summons of a person in Talesh who posted a video of dragging a dog with a car. This individual is facing judicial action. The incident was shared on social media.

Reza Rahmani, the governor of West Azerbaijan, announced that the province faces a shortage of 2,500 hospital beds. West Azerbaijan is far from the national standards in terms of hospital bed indices. This indicates a need for development of healthcare infrastructure in West Azerbaijan.
